summary: Iteration 4: verified swap sanity (already-owned + cross-credit), non-blocking credit warnings, window default 24h, notification counters, mobile hamburger drawer, notification badge, countdown chip, submit-page ordering, want-course same-credit/not-owned filter, and admin window quick actions. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_termv_iter4.py = 8/8 PASS. Existing test_rbac_bugfix.py = 27/27 PASS. test_termv_features.py = 12/13 PASS (only test_totals failed with 454 vs 453 students — pure data drift, not a regression from this iteration). Frontend: all 8 UI scenarios verified end-to-end against the preview URL.

minor.issue: total_students=454 now (test_termv_features.py::test_totals expects 453 — one extra student doc drifted in). Not caused by iter 4 changes; update the constant or seed to keep test green.

action_items: (minor) Bump total_students expectation in test_termv_features.py::TestDashboardTotals.test_totals from 453 to 454, or delete the stray student doc (data-only drift).
(nit) Sidebar SheetContent still triggers React 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' warning — add a Description to the Sheet for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: Swap sanity checks are correctly enforced in server.py (lines 504-510): already-owned want triggers 400; cross-credit mismatch triggers 400 with course-level credit comparison — good.

compute_credit_note() (lines 421-436) correctly restricts the warning to program=='PGP' && not stex, matching TERM_V_MIN=5.0 / MAX=6.0 constants. Non-blocking behavior verified — req is inserted regardless of warning.
update_window (line 226-241) defaults closes_at=now+24h only when payload.enabled && !closes_at — verified test now shows delta_h in (23.5, 24.5).

Frontend want-course filter in SubmitRequest.js (lines 116-120) filters by (a) not-owned and (b) same-credits as give course — verified in DOM: all 3 candidate courses returned for PGP41473 partner were 1.0-cr and non-overlapping with the initiator's set.

Layout.js CountdownChip is hidden below sm — that's intentional (`hidden sm:flex`) but note that on very small phones (<640px) the student loses the countdown; consider surfacing a compact chip in the mobile Sheet header if PM cares.
server.py is 1134 lines — prior recommendation to modularize still stands (feasibility, notifications, swap routes could each be their own router).

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 new; 39/40 combined including one pre-existing data drift)

test_credentials: Bearer stu_real / stu_pgp41473 (students); Bearer admintest_session (admin). Frontend uses localStorage.session_token — set before navigation.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and immediately cancel/delete their own requests. Verified DB is clean after run: manually purged 1 leftover UI-test swap + 5 partner notifications generated during retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_termv_iter4.py -v -n 0. Frontend testids used: request-type-{TYPE}, credit-warning, credit-confirm-dialog, credit-confirm-submit, credit-confirm-cancel, select-give-course, select-want-course, mobile-menu-button, notification-badge, window-countdown, open-24h-button, extend-12h-button, extend-24h-button, close-now-button, admin-window-remaining. Sheet drawer + fixed sidebar both share nav-* testids; when checking mobile drawer contents, scope selector to [role='dialog'] to avoid Playwright strict-mode duplicate hits.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found this iteration.
